summary: ZKH Group Ltd published its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results via Form 6-K. The filing contains operational and financial highlights including GMV growth, revenue increases, and narrowing losses. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is announced. The filing is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer.
